∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring.{u_1} A] (V : Type u_2) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V] [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} A V]
  [Nontrivial.{u_2} V],
  Iff (Etingof.Problem2_5_2.IsCyclic.{u_1, u_2} V)
    (Exists.{u_1 + 1} fun I =>
      Nonempty.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)}
        (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_1} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) V (HasQuotient.Quotient.{u_1, u_1} A I)))
